ops.body:
cc-sync phase 2a complete: cc-sync/integration @ a28fec045ebb (Run wf_ce100eb1-460). No production seam is still fake-backed. It merges F23, D7 (+clarification), D13 wiring, the Orca binding-key API + D2 sessionIdMap + capability-gated D1 recoveryLaunch, D15 sparse surfacing/--apply-sparse, the pickup mapping/aliases, omittedBindings surfaced as `not_restorable`, and concrete synckit/reposync/sessionrestore wiring. One helperclient is shared by service/installer/picker, and a race-tested real-socket round trip covers it. Gates with go.work pass: build/vet, race -count=2 across all 16 packages, lint 0.
Real binary smoke:
- `--help` exits 0.
- `status --json` without synckitd returns one JSON line, exit 5, code unavailable.
- `list --json` on an empty config gives ok:true and items:[].
- Against the INSTALLED (older) synckitd, status/list fail with "unknown method delivery.status".
Open items:
- (1) go.mod still requires synckit v0.39.2 and reposync v0.30.1, so PR CI needs a bump to pseudo-versions of the pushed final branches. The cc-sync draft PR opens right after the reposync final merge pushes. The lane pinned a local-only reposync merge ab983c7 for now; it is superseded by the reposync final.
- (2) Map an old synckitd to a typed "synckitd too old (needs >= v0.40.0)" unavailable error via a version preflight, not string matching.
- (3) `status` degrades: it shows the helper and network with delivery marked unavailable instead of failing outright.
- (4) A real install→status→sync→pickup on this machine requires installing the new synckitd over the live synckitd. That is the controlled-rollout gate (no unverified rollout over live sessions); the E2E harness covers it in-process until then.
Items 2 and 3 go into phase 2b.
